DUSTLINE

BROKEN SIGNAL

0730 HRS / KOHAR VALLEY

A village gone silent.

A relief convoy has lost contact in the valley. Viper squad must recover the missing route log, restore the village relay, and reach the extraction point before the road closes.

  1. Recover the route log inside the field office.
  2. Clear and restore the radio relay.
  3. Reach the eastern extraction courtyard.
  1. Alone, survive escalating waves in the courtyard west of the field office. No squad: every kill, point and risk is yours. There is no win: last as long as you can.
  2. Your kills earn points (headshots more). At a barricade press E to clear it and open the next area. At a weapon crate: E buys that rifle (it comes with five magazines), B a magazine for the rifle you hold, N a field dressing (use it with H). Prices rise as the waves climb.
  3. Stay inside the striped yellow line. Five seconds outside it ends the run.
  4. From wave 5, between waves: X to extract and bank your points, or V to stay for a bigger bank. Dying banks nothing.

Two-player co-op · Experimental

Exchange codes with a trusted teammate. 1 · The host presses CREATE HOST CODE, then COPY CODE, and sends the code. 2 · The teammate pastes it, presses JOIN WITH CODE, then COPY CODE, and sends the answer back. 3 · The host pastes the answer and presses ACCEPT ANSWER. Keep both pages open and do not reload. Some networks cannot connect directly (there is no relay server). Direct connections share network addresses; setup uses Google STUN.

Choose Create host code or paste a host code and join.
